test_title: PYST 15: SSC CHSL 2023 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Kalyan invested a sum of ₹12,000 for two years compounded at 5% and 10%, respectively. What is the compound interest (in ₹) at the end of two years?
solution:
**Given:** 

Principal (P) = ₹12,000

First-year interest rate (r1) = 5%

Second-year interest rate (r2) = 10% 

**Calculation:**

A1 = P(1 + r1)

A1 = 12000(1 + 0.05)

A1 = 12000 × 1.05 = ₹12,600

Second Year: For the second year, we use the amount at the end of the first year as the principal.

P2 = A1 (the amount from the first year becomes the principal for the second year)

A2 = P2(1 + r2)

A2 = 12600(1 + 0.1)

A2 = 12600 × 1.1 = ₹13,860

Compound Interest = A2 - P

Compound Interest = 13860 - 12000
